# Global CO₂ Emissions: Trends, Regional Shifts, and Per Capita Inequalities

## Source
https://climate.nasa.gov/vital-signs/carbon-dioxide/ and Our World in Data — CO₂ and Greenhouse Gas Emissions (Global Carbon Budget 2025)

## Atmospheric CO₂ Concentration

The latest measurement from NOAA's Mauna Loa Observatory (February 2026) records atmospheric CO₂ at **429 parts per million (ppm)**. This represents a more than 50% increase from the pre-industrial baseline of approximately 280 ppm. The current level is at least 1.5 times greater than the natural increase observed at the end of the last ice age 20,000 years ago — a change that took thousands of years then but has occurred in roughly two centuries now. Ground-based and satellite measurements confirm the sharp acceleration, linked primarily to the burning of coal, oil, and natural gas.

## Global Emissions Trajectory (1750–2024)

Before the Industrial Revolution, CO₂ emissions were negligible. Growth remained relatively slow until the mid-20th century. In **1950**, the world emitted roughly **6 billion tonnes** of CO₂. By **1990**, emissions had nearly quadrupled to over **20 billion tonnes**. Today, global annual emissions from fossil fuels and industry exceed **35 billion tonnes**. While emissions growth has slowed in recent years, they have not yet peaked.

![Annual CO₂ emissions by country](./assets/figure_3.jpg)

## Who Emits the Most? Country-Level Totals

China is the world's largest emitter by a significant margin, producing over 12 billion tonnes annually — more than one-quarter of the global total. The United States peaked near 6 billion tonnes around 2005 and has since declined to roughly 5 billion tonnes. India has risen rapidly to approximately 3 billion tonnes. Europe's share has fallen substantially.

| Country / Region | Approx. Annual CO₂ (billion t) | Share of Global | Trend (recent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| China | ~12.5 | ~27% | Slight increase |
| United States | ~5.0 | ~14% | Declining |
| India | ~3.0 | ~8% | Rising |
| EU-27 | ~2.7 | ~7% | Declining |
| Germany | ~0.6 | ~1.7% | Declining |
| United Kingdom | ~0.3 | ~0.9% | Declining |
| Brazil | ~0.5 | ~1.4% | Roughly stable |
| France | ~0.3 | ~0.8% | Declining |

In 1900, Europe and the US accounted for more than 90% of global emissions. By 1950, they still represented over 85%. Today, they account for less than one-third, while Asia — home to nearly 60% of the world's population — produces roughly half of all emissions. Africa and South America each contribute only 3–4%, comparable to international aviation and shipping combined.

## Per Capita Emissions: Extreme Inequalities

Per capita CO₂ emissions reveal stark global inequalities. The world's highest per capita emitters are major oil-producing nations with small populations (Qatar, UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait). Among large, populous countries, the US, Australia, and Canada have per capita emissions roughly three times the global average.

![Per capita CO₂ emissions over time](./assets/figure_1.jpg)

| Country | Per Capita CO₂ (tonnes/year) |
|---|---|
| United States | ~15 |
| Canada | ~13 |
| Australia | ~15 |
| South Africa | ~8 |
| China | ~9 |
| EU-27 | ~7 |
| World average | ~5 |
| United Kingdom | ~4 |
| France | ~4 |
| India | ~2 |
| Kenya | <1 |
| Chad / Niger | ~0.1 |

The gap between the highest and lowest per capita emitters is approximately **150-fold**: the average American or Australian emits in under two days what the average person in Chad or Niger emits in an entire year. Importantly, countries with similar living standards can differ significantly — France and the UK have much lower per capita emissions than Germany or the Netherlands, largely because of their energy mix (higher nuclear and renewable shares).

## 2024 Annual Change in Emissions

The 2024 map of annual percentage change in CO₂ emissions shows a mixed picture. The United States and much of Europe recorded declines (roughly −1% to −5%), shown in blue. Russia, parts of Southeast Asia, and several African nations saw increases of +2% to +10% or more, shown in orange and red. Some countries in South America (notably one or two) experienced very large percentage increases (>10%), while others saw declines.

![Annual percentage change in CO₂ emissions, 2024](./assets/figure_4.jpg)

## Key Findings

- **Global CO₂ emissions now exceed 35 billion tonnes per year** and have not yet peaked, despite slowing growth rates.
- **China alone accounts for over 25% of global emissions** (~12.5 Bt), more than double the United States (~5 Bt); India (~3 Bt) is the third-largest and rising fast.
- **The geographic center of emissions has shifted dramatically**: from >90% in Europe and the US in 1900 to Asia producing ~50% today, while the US and Europe combined are below one-third.
- **Per capita inequalities are extreme** — a 150× gap separates the highest emitters (US, Australia at ~15 t/person) from the lowest (Chad, Niger at ~0.1 t/person).
- **Energy mix and policy choices matter**: countries with similar prosperity levels (e.g., France vs. Germany) can have very different per capita emissions depending on their reliance on nuclear, renewables, or fossil fuels.

7

The current level is at least 1.5 times greater than the natural increase observed at the end of the last ice age 20,000 years ago — a change that took thousands of years then but has occurred in roughly two centuries now. 10	## Global Emissions Trajectory (1750–2024)
11	
12	Before the Industrial Revolution, CO₂ emissions were negligible. Growth remained relatively slow until the mid-20th century. In **1950**, the world emitted roughly **6 billion tonnes** of CO₂. """Build the Global CO2 Emissions PowerPoint presentation."""
import os
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.chart.data import ChartData
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE
import pptx.oxml.ns as ns
from lxml import etree

# ── Color palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DARK_NAVY   = RGBColor(0x0D, 0x1B, 0x2A)   # backgrounds
MID_BLUE    = RGBColor(0x1B, 0x4F, 0x72)   # accent / headers
ACCENT_TEAL = RGBColor(0x17, 0x93, 0x9A)   # highlight callouts
LIGHT_GREY  = RGBColor(0xF2, 0xF3, 0xF4)   # body bg alternate
WHITE       = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
ORANGE      = RGBColor(0xE6, 0x7E, 0x22)
RED_ACCENT  = RGBColor(0xC0, 0x39, 0x2B)
GREEN       = RGBColor(0x1E, 0x8B, 0x4C)
TEXT_DARK   = RGBColor(0x1C, 0x1C, 0x1C)

SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

ASSETS = "/app/benchmark/assets"
OUT    = "/app/output/final_deck.pptx"

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width  = SLIDE_W
prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H

blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # completely blank

# ── Helper utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def add_rect(slide, x, y, w, h, fill_color=None, line_color=None, line_width=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, x, y, w, h)  # MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.RECTANGLE = 1
    fill = shape.fill
    if fill_color:
        fill.solid()
        fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    else:
        fill.background()
    line = shape.line
    if line_color:
        line.color.rgb = line_color
        if line_width:
            line.width = line_width
    else:
        line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_text_box(slide, text, x, y, w, h,
                 font_size=18, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                 align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, wrap=True, italic=False,
                 line_spacing=None):
    txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x, y, w, h)
    tf  = txb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = wrap
    p   = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    if line_spacing:
        from pptx.util import Pt as _Pt
        from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
        from lxml import etree
        pPr = p._pPr
        if pPr is None:
            pPr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
        lnSpc = etree.SubElement(pPr, qn('a:lnSpc'))
        spcPct = etree.SubElement(lnSpc, qn('a:spcPct'))
        spcPct.set('val', str(int(line_spacing * 1000)))
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size  = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold  = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.italic = italic
    return txb

def add_para(tf, text, font_size=16, bold=False, color=TEXT_DARK,
             align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, space_before=None, italic=False, bullet_char=""):
    from pptx.util import Pt as _Pt
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.alignment = align
    if space_before:
        p.space_before = _Pt(space_before)
    if bullet_char:
        run0 = p.add_run()
        run0.text = bullet_char + " "
        run0.font.size = _Pt(font_size)
        run0.font.color.rgb = ACCENT_TEAL
        run0.font.bold = True
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size  = _Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold  = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.italic = italic
    return p

def header_band(slide, title_text, subtitle_text=None):
    """Top band with title."""
    add_rect(slide, 0, 0, SLIDE_W, Inches(1.2), fill_color=DARK_NAVY)
    add_text_box(slide, title_text, Inches(0.4), Inches(0.12), Inches(12.5), Inches(0.8),
                 font_size=28, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
    if subtitle_text:
        add_text_box(slide, subtitle_text, Inches(0.4), Inches(0.85), Inches(12.5), Inches(0.35),
                     font_size=13, bold=False, color=ACCENT_TEAL, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

def footer_band(slide, text="Global Carbon Budget 2025 · NASA NOAA · Our World in Data"):
    add_rect(slide, 0, Inches(7.1), SLIDE_W, Inches(0.4), fill_color=MID_BLUE)
    add_text_box(slide, text, Inches(0.4), Inches(7.12), Inches(12.5), Inches(0.35),
                 font_size=10, color=RGBColor(0xBD, 0xD7, 0xEE), align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

def slide_bg(slide, color=LIGHT_GREY):
    add_rect(slide, 0, 0, SLIDE_W, SLIDE_H, fill_color=color)

def add_image(slide, path, x, y, w, h):
    if os.path.exists(path):
        slide.shapes.add_picture(path, x, y, w, h)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 1 — Title slide
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
s1 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
# Full dark background
add_rect(s1, 0, 0, SLIDE_W, SLIDE_H, fill_color=DARK_NAVY)
# Accent bar left
add_rect(s1, 0, 0, Inches(0.25), SLIDE_H, fill_color=ACCENT_TEAL)
# Central content block
add_rect(s1, Inches(0.5), Inches(1.8), Inches(9.5), Inches(0.07), fill_color=ACCENT_TEAL)
# Main title
add_text_box(s1, "Global CO₂ Emissions", Inches(0.5), Inches(1.9), Inches(12.3), Inches(1.1),
             font_size=44, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
add_text_box(s1, "Trends, Regional Shifts, and Per Capita Inequalities",
             Inches(0.5), Inches(2.9), Inches(11.0), Inches(0.8),
             font_size=28, bold=False, color=RGBColor(0xAE, 0xD6, 0xF1), align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
# Scope pill
scope_box = add_rect(s1, Inches(0.5), Inches(3.85), Inches(3.5), Inches(0.5), fill_color=MID_BLUE)
add_text_box(s1, "1750 – 2024  |  Global Scope", Inches(0.55), Inches(3.87), Inches(3.4), Inches(0.44),
             font_size=14, bold=False, color=ACCENT_TEAL, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
# Audience line
add_text_box(s1, "For: Policy Analysts & Climate Negotiators",
             Inches(0.5), Inches(4.5), Inches(9.0), Inches(0.4),
             font_size=13, color=RGBColor(0x85, 0xC1, 0xE9), align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
# Source attribution
add_text_box(s1, "Sources: Global Carbon Budget 2025  ·  NASA Mauna Loa Observatory  ·  Our World in Data",
             Inches(0.5), Inches(6.6), Inches(12.0), Inches(0.4),
             font_size=11, color=RGBColor(0x71, 0x90, 0xA8), align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 2 — Atmospheric CO₂ Reaches 429 ppm
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
s2 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
slide_bg(s2, LIGHT_GREY)
header_band(s2, "Atmospheric CO₂ Reaches 429 ppm — 50% Above Pre-Industrial Levels",
            "Mauna Loa Observatory, NOAA · February 2026")
footer_band(s2)

# Large callout stat box
add_rect(s2, Inches(0.4), Inches(1.35), Inches(5.8), Inches(3.5), fill_color=DARK_NAVY)
add_text_box(s2, "429", Inches(0.5), Inches(1.45), Inches(5.6), Inches(1.8),
             font_size=100, bold=True, color=ACCENT_TEAL, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(s2, "parts per million (ppm)", Inches(0.5), Inches(3.05), Inches(5.6), Inches(0.5),
             font_size=18, bold=False, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(s2, "February 2026 · Mauna Loa Observatory", Inches(0.5), Inches(3.55), Inches(5.6), Inches(0.4),
             font_size=11, color=RGBColor(0x85, 0xC1, 0xE9), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(s2, "+53%\nvs. pre-industrial baseline", Inches(0.5), Inches(4.05), Inches(5.6), Inches(0.7),
             font_size=15, bold=True, color=ORANGE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Timeline comparison boxes
box_data = [
    ("Pre-Industrial\n(~1750)", "~280 ppm", MID_BLUE, WHITE),
    ("Keeling Curve\nbegins (1958)", "~315 ppm", MID_BLUE, WHITE),
    ("Today\n(Feb 2026)", "429 ppm", RED_ACCENT, WHITE),
]
for i, (label, val, bg, fg) in enumerate(box_data):
    bx = Inches(6.5) + i * Inches(2.2)
    add_rect(s2, bx, Inches(1.5), Inches(2.0), Inches(1.6), fill_color=bg)
    add_text_box(s2, label, bx + Inches(0.05), Inches(1.55), Inches(1.9), Inches(0.75),
                 font_size=12, color=RGBColor(0xAE, 0xD6, 0xF1), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    add_text_box(s2, val, bx + Inches(0.05), Inches(2.2), Inches(1.9), Inches(0.7),
                 font_size=22, bold=True, color=fg, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Key context text
ctx_txb = s2.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(6.5), Inches(3.35), Inches(6.6), Inches(3.4))
ctx_tf  = ctx_txb.text_frame
ctx_tf.word_wrap = True
add_para(ctx_tf, "Key Context", font_size=14, bold=True, color=MID_BLUE)
add_para(ctx_tf, "The 429 ppm level represents more than a 50% increase over the pre-industrial baseline of ~280 ppm.",
         font_size=13, color=TEXT_DARK, bullet_char="▸", space_before=4)
add_para(ctx_tf, "This increase is at least 1.5× faster than the natural rise at the end of the last ice age — achieved in ~200 years vs. thousands.",
         font_size=13, color=TEXT_DARK, bullet_char="▸", space_before=4)
add_para(ctx_tf, "Ground-based and satellite measurements confirm sharp acceleration driven by fossil fuel combustion.",
         font_size=13, color=TEXT_DARK, bullet_char="▸", space_before=4)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 3 — Global Emissions Grew Six-Fold
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
s3 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
slide_bg(s3, LIGHT_GREY)
header_band(s3, "Global Fossil Fuel CO₂ Emissions Grew Six-Fold: 6 Billion to 35+ Billion Tonnes",
            "Annual global CO₂ from fossil fuels & industry, 1750–2024  ·  figure_2 reference")
footer_band(s3)

# Three milestone stat boxes
milestones = [
    ("1950", "~6 Bt", "Starting point of\npost-war industrial acceleration", MID_BLUE),
    ("1990", "~20 Bt", "Nearly 4× the 1950 level;\nfollowing Cold War growth", MID_BLUE),
    ("2024", "35+ Bt", "All-time high; emissions have\nnot yet peaked", RED_ACCENT),
]
for i, (yr, val, note, col) in enumerate(milestones):
    bx = Inches(0.4) + i * Inches(4.2)
    add_rect(s3, bx, Inches(1.4), Inches(3.8), Inches(2.0), fill_color=col)
    add_text_box(s3, yr, bx + Inches(0.1), Inches(1.5), Inches(3.6), Inches(0.6),
                 font_size=28, bold=True, color=ACCENT_TEAL, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    add_text_box(s3, val, bx + Inches(0.1), Inches(2.0), Inches(3.6), Inches(0.75),
                 font_size=36, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    add_text_box(s3, note, bx + Inches(0.1), Inches(2.7), Inches(3.6), Inches(0.65),
                 font_size=12, color=RGBColor(0xAE, 0xD6, 0xF1), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Arrow connectors (text-based)
add_text_box(s3, "→ ×3.3", Inches(4.2), Inches(2.1), Inches(0.8), Inches(0.5),
             font_size=16, bold=True, color=ORANGE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text_box(s3, "→ ×1.75", Inches(8.4), Inches(2.1), Inches(0.95), Inches(0.5),
             font_size=16, bold=True, color=ORANGE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Narrative below
narr_txb = s3.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.4), Inches(3.6), Inches(12.6), Inches(3.1))
narr_tf  = narr_txb.text_frame
narr_tf.word_wrap = True
add_para(narr_tf, "Trajectory Highlights", font_size=14, bold=True, color=MID_BLUE)
add_para(narr_tf, "Before the Industrial Revolution, CO₂ emissions were negligible. Growth was slow until the mid-20th century.",
         font_size=13, color=TEXT_DARK, bullet_char="▸", space_before=4)
add_para(narr_tf, "Post-1950 acceleration was driven by expanded coal, oil, and gas use — primarily in industrialised nations.",
         font_size=13, color=TEXT_DARK, bullet_char="▸", space_before=4)
add_para(narr_tf, "Despite recent slowing, global emissions have not yet peaked — continued growth in emerging economies offsets declines in the US and EU.",
         font_size=13, color=TEXT_DARK, bullet_char="▸", space_before=4)
add_para(narr_tf, "Note: figure_2 (annual totals line chart, 1750–2024) provides the full visual trajectory.",
         font_size=11, color=RGBColor(0x7F, 0x8C, 0x8D), italic=True, space_before=6)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 4 — China vs. US total emissions + figure_3
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
s4 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
slide_bg(s4, LIGHT_GREY)
header_band(s4, "China Now Emits Over 12 Billion Tonnes — More Than Double the United States",
            "Annual total CO₂ by major emitter, 2024 estimates  ·  figure_3")
footer_band(s4)

fig3_path = os.path.join(ASSETS, "figure_3.jpg")
add_image(s4, fig3_path, Inches(0.35), Inches(1.3), Inches(7.4), Inches(5.4))

# Data table on right
table_data = [
    ("Country / Region", "CO₂ (Bt/yr)", "Global %", "Trend"),
    ("China",            "~12.5",       "~27%",     "↑ slight increase"),
    ("United States",    "~5.0",        "~14%",     "↓ declining"),
    ("India",            "~3.0",        "~8%",      "↑ rising fast"),
    ("EU-27",            "~2.7",        "~7%",      "↓ declining"),
    ("Germany",          "~0.6",        "~1.7%",    "↓ declining"),
    ("Brazil",           "~0.5",        "~1.4%",    "→ stable"),
    ("France",           "~0.3",        "~0.8%",    "↓ declining"),
    ("United Kingdom",   "~0.3",        "~0.9%",    "↓ declining"),
]
col_widths = [Inches(2.1), Inches(1.1), Inches(0.9), Inches(1.5)]
row_h = Inches(0.48)
tx = Inches(7.9)
ty = Inches(1.3)
for r, row in enumerate(table_data):
    for c, cell in enumerate(row):
        cx = tx + sum(col_widths[:c])
        bg = DARK_NAVY if r == 0 else (RGBColor(0xE8, 0xF0, 0xFE) if r % 2 == 0 else WHITE)
        fg = WHITE if r == 0 else TEXT_DARK
        if c == 0 and r == 1:  # China highlight
            bg = RGBColor(0xFD, 0xED, 0xEC)
        add_rect(s4, cx, ty + r * row_h, col_widths[c], row_h, fill_color=bg)
        fs = 11 if r == 0 else 10.5
        bd = r == 0
        col_color = fg
        if r == 1 and c == 0:
            col_color = RED_ACCENT
        add_text_box(s4, cell, cx + Inches(0.06), ty + r * row_h + Inches(0.08),
                     col_widths[c] - Inches(0.08), row_h - Inches(0.1),
                     font_size=fs, bold=bd, color=col_color, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 5 — Regional share shift
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
s5 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
slide_bg(s5, LIGHT_GREY)
header_band(s5, "Asia Now Accounts for ~50% of Global Emissions; US + Europe Below One-Third",
            "Regional emission shares: 1900 vs. 2024  ·  Dramatic geographic shift")
footer_band(s5)

# Two comparison "pie-like" bar stacks side by side
# 1900 data
regions_1900 = [
    ("Europe",       62, RGBColor(0x1B, 0x4F, 0x72)),
    ("United States",30, RGBColor(0x27, 0x6D, 0xAE)),
    ("Rest of World", 8, RGBColor(0x85, 0xC1, 0xE9)),
]
# 2024 data
regions_2024 = [
    ("Asia",            50, RGBColor(0xC0, 0x39, 0x2B)),
    ("United States",   14, RGBColor(0x27, 0x6D, 0xAE)),
    ("EU-27",            7, RGBColor(0x1B, 0x4F, 0x72)),
    ("Africa",           4, RGBColor(0xE6, 0x7E, 0x22)),
    ("South America",    4, RGBColor(0xF3, 0x9C, 0x12)),
    ("Other",           21, RGBColor(0xAE, 0xD6, 0xF1)),
]

bar_total_h = Inches(4.0)
bar_w = Inches(2.2)

def stacked_bar(slide, regions, bx, by, bw, bh, title):
    add_text_box(slide, title, bx, by - Inches(0.5), bw, Inches(0.45),
                 font_size=18, bold=True, color=MID_BLUE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    cum = 0
    for name, pct, col in regions:
        seg_h = bh * (pct / 100)
        seg_y = by + (bh - cum * bh / 100 - seg_h)
        add_rect(slide, bx, seg_y, bw, seg_h, fill_color=col)
        if pct >= 7:
            add_text_box(slide, f"{name}\n{pct}%", bx + Inches(0.05), seg_y + Inches(0.05),
                         bw - Inches(0.1), seg_h - Inches(0.1),
                         font_size=12, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        cum += pct

stacked_bar(s5, regions_1900, Inches(1.2), Inches(1.7), bar_w, bar_total_h, "1900")
stacked_bar(s5, regions_2024, Inches(4.2), Inches(1.7), bar_w, bar_total_h, "2024")

# Arrow between them
add_text_box(s5, "→", Inches(3.55), Inches(3.4), Inches(0.6), Inches(0.6),
             font_size=36, bold=True, color=ACCENT_TEAL, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Key narrative on right
narr2_txb = s5.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(7.0), Inches(1.5), Inches(6.0), Inches(5.2))
narr2_tf  = narr2_txb.text_frame
narr2_tf.word_wrap = True
add_para(narr2_tf, "What Changed?", font_size=15, bold=True, color=MID_BLUE)
add_para(narr2_tf, "In 1900, Europe and the US together accounted for more than 90% of global CO₂ emissions.",
         font_size=13, color=TEXT_DARK, bullet_char="▸", space_before=5)
add_para(narr2_tf, "By 1950, they still represented over 85% of emissions.",
         font_size=13, color=TEXT_DARK, bullet_char="▸", space_before=5)
add_para(narr2_tf, "Today, Asia — home to ~60% of the world's population — produces roughly 50% of all emissions.",
         font_size=13, color=TEXT_DARK, bullet_char="▸", space_before=5)
add_para(narr2_tf, "The US + Europe combined now account for less than one-third of global emissions.",
         font_size=13, color=TEXT_DARK, bullet_char="▸", space_before=5)
add_para(narr2_tf, "Africa and South America each contribute only 3–4%, comparable to international aviation and shipping combined.",
         font_size=13, color=TEXT_DARK, bullet_char="▸", space_before=5)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 6 — Per capita 150× gap + figure_1
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
s6 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
slide_bg(s6, LIGHT_GREY)
header_band(s6, "Per Capita Gap: 15 t in the US vs. 0.1 t in Chad — a 150× Disparity",
            "Per capita CO₂ emissions (tonnes/person/year), 2024  ·  figure_1")
footer_band(s6)

# Horizontal bar chart (manual shapes)
bar_data = [
    ("United States",  15.0, RED_ACCENT),
    ("Canada",         13.0, ORANGE),
    ("China",           9.0, RGBColor(0xE8, 0x9B, 0x2E)),
    ("EU-27",           7.0, MID_BLUE),
    ("World Average",   5.0, ACCENT_TEAL),
    ("United Kingdom",  4.0, RGBColor(0x27, 0xAE, 0x60)),
    ("India",           2.0, GREEN),
    ("Kenya",           0.9, RGBColor(0x7F, 0xBF, 0xFF)),
    ("Chad/Niger",      0.1, LIGHT_GREY),
]
max_val = 15.0
bar_max_w = Inches(5.8)
bx_origin = Inches(2.5)
by_start   = Inches(1.35)
row_h2     = Inches(0.52)
bar_h2     = Inches(0.36)

for i, (name, val, col) in enumerate(bar_data):
    by = by_start + i * row_h2
    bw = bar_max_w * (val / max_val)
    # Label
    add_text_box(s6, name, Inches(0.25), by, Inches(2.1), bar_h2,
                 font_size=12, bold=(name in ("United States", "Chad/Niger", "World Average")),
                 color=TEXT_DARK, align=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)
    # Bar
    add_rect(s6, bx_origin, by, max(bw, Inches(0.08)), bar_h2, fill_color=col)
    # Value label
    add_text_box(s6, f"{val} t", bx_origin + bw + Inches(0.08), by, Inches(0.8), bar_h2,
                 font_size=11, bold=True, color=TEXT_DARK, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

# World average dashed line annotation
avg_x = bx_origin + bar_max_w * (5.0 / 15.0)

"""Build the Global CO2 Emissions PowerPoint presentation."""
import os
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.chart.data import ChartData
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE
import pptx.oxml.ns as ns
from lxml import etree

# ── Color palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DARK_NAVY   = RGBColor(0x0D, 0x1B, 0x2A)   # backgrounds
MID_BLUE    = RGBColor(0x1B, 0x4F, 0x72)   # accent / headers
ACCENT_TEAL = RGBColor(0x17, 0x93, 0x9A)   # highlight callouts
LIGHT_GREY  = RGBColor(0xF2, 0xF3, 0xF4)   # body bg alternate
WHITE       = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
ORANGE      = RGBColor(0xE6, 0x7E, 0x22)
RED_ACCENT  = RGBColor(0xC0, 0x39, 0x2B)
GREEN       = RGBColor(0x1E, 0x8B, 0x4C)
TEXT_DARK   = RGBColor(0x1C, 0x1C, 0x1C)

SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

ASSETS = "/app/benchmark/assets"
OUT    = "/app/output/final_deck.pptx"

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width  = SLIDE_W
prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H

blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # completely blank

# ── Helper utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def add_rect(slide, x, y, w, h, fill_color=None, line_color=None, line_width=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, x, y, w, h)  # MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.RECTANGLE = 1
    fill = shape.fill
    if fill_color:
        fill.solid()
        fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    else:
        fill.background()
    line = shape.line
    if line_color:
        line.color.rgb = line_color
        if line_width:
            line.width = line_width
    else:
        line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_text_box(slide, text, x, y, w, h,
                 font_size=18, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                 align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, wrap=True, italic=False,
                 line_spacing=None):
    txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x, y, w, h)
    tf  = txb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = wrap
    p   = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    if line_spacing:
        from pptx.util import Pt as _Pt
        from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
        from lxml import etree
        pPr = p._pPr
        if pPr is None:
            pPr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
        lnSpc = etree.SubElement(pPr, qn('a:lnSpc'))
        spcPct = etree.SubElement(lnSpc, qn('a:spcPct'))
        spcPct.set('val', str(int(line_spacing * 1000)))
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size  = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold  = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.italic = italic
    return txb

def add_para(tf, text, font_size=16, bold=False, color=TEXT_DARK,
             align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, space_before=None, italic=False, bullet_char=""):
    from pptx.util import Pt as _Pt
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.alignment = align
    if space_before:
        p.space_before = _Pt(space_before)
    if bullet_char:
        run0 = p.add_run()
        run0.text = bullet_char + " "
        run0.font.size = _Pt(font_size)
        run0.font.color.rgb = ACCENT_TEAL
        run0.font.bold = True
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size  = _Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold  = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.italic = italic
    return p

def header_band(slide, title_text, subtitle_text=None):
    """Top band with title."""
    add_rect(slide, 0, 0, SLIDE_W, Inches(1.2), fill_color=DARK_NAVY)
    add_text_box(slide, title_text, Inches(0.4), Inches(0.12), Inches(12.5), Inches(0.8),

def add_rect(slide, x, y, w, h, fill_color=None, line_color=None, line_width=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, x, y, w, h)  # MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.RECTANGLE = 1
    fill = shape.fill
    if fill_color:
        fill.solid()
        fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    else:
        fill.background()
    line = shape.line
    if line_color:
        line.color.rgb = line_color
        if line_width:
            line.width = line_width
    else:
        line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_text_box(slide, text, x, y, w, h,
                 font_size=18, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                 align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, wrap=True, italic=False,
                 line_spacing=None):
    txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x, y, w, h)
    tf  = txb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = wrap
    p   = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    if line_spacing:
        from pptx.util import Pt as _Pt
        from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
        from lxml import etree
        pPr = p._pPr
        if pPr is None:
            pPr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
        lnSpc = etree.SubElement(pPr, qn('a:lnSpc'))
        spcPct = etree.SubElement(lnSpc, qn('a:spcPct'))
        spcPct.set('val', str(int(line_spacing * 1000)))
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size  = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold  = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.italic = italic
    return txb

def add_para(tf, text, font_size=16, bold=False, color=TEXT_DARK,
             align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, space_before=None, italic=False, bullet_char=""):
    from pptx.util import Pt as _Pt
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.alignment = align
    if space_before:
        p.space_before = _Pt(space_before)
    if bullet_char:
        run0 = p.add_run()
        run0.text = bullet_char + " "
        run0.font.size = _Pt(font_size)
        run0.font.color.rgb = ACCENT_TEAL
        run0.font.bold = True
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size  = _Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold  = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.italic = italic
    return p

"""Build the Global CO2 Emissions PowerPoint presentation."""
import os
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu

from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

from lxml import etree

# ── Color palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DARK_NAVY   = RGBColor(0x0D, 0x1B, 0x2A)   # backgrounds
MID_BLUE    = RGBColor(0x1B, 0x4F, 0x72)   # accent / headers
ACCENT_TEAL = RGBColor(0x17, 0x93, 0x9A)   # highlight callouts
LIGHT_GREY  = RGBColor(0xF2, 0xF3, 0xF4)   # body bg alternate
WHITE       = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
ORANGE      = RGBColor(0xE6, 0x7E, 0x22)
RED_ACCENT  = RGBColor(0xC0, 0x39, 0x2B)
GREEN       = RGBColor(0x1E, 0x8B, 0x4C)
TEXT_DARK   = RGBColor(0x1C, 0x1C, 0x1C)

SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

ASSETS = "/app/benchmark/assets"
OUT    = "/app/output/final_deck.pptx"

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width  = SLIDE_W
prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H

blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # completely blank

# ── Helper utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def add_rect(slide, x, y, w, h, fill_color=None, line_color=None, line_width=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, x, y, w, h)  # MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.RECTANGLE = 1
    fill = shape.fill
    if fill_color:
        fill.solid()
        fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    else:
        fill.background()
    line = shape.line
    if line_color:
        line.color.rgb = line_color
        if line_width:
            line.width = line_width
    else:
        line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_text_box(slide, text, x, y, w, h,
                 font_size=18, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                 align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, wrap=True, italic=False,
                 line_spacing=None):
    txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x, y, w, h)
    tf  = txb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = wrap
    p   = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    if line_spacing:
        from pptx.util import Pt as _Pt
        from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
        from lxml import etree
        pPr = p._pPr
        if pPr is None:
            pPr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
        lnSpc = etree.SubElement(pPr, qn('a:lnSpc'))
        spcPct = etree.SubElement(lnSpc, qn('a:spcPct'))
        spcPct.set('val', str(int(line_spacing * 1000)))
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size  = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold  = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.italic = italic
    return txb

def add_para(tf, text, font_size=16, bold=False, color=TEXT_DARK,
             align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, space_before=None, italic=False, bullet_char=""):
    from pptx.util import Pt as _Pt
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.alignment = align
    if space_before:
        p.space_before = _Pt(space_before)
    if bullet_char:
        run0 = p.add_run()
        run0.text = bullet_char + " "
        run0.font.size = _Pt(font_size)
        run0.font.color.rgb = ACCENT_TEAL
        run0.font.bold = True
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size  = _Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold  = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.italic = italic
    return p

    add_text_box(slide, title_text, Inches(0.4), Inches(0.12), Inches(12.5), Inches(0.8),
                 font_size=28, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
